title: A whole named companion with her own unresolved grief — Tamsin, at the Vale forge, who 'never went looking for what took her mother' per the ending recap — is mentioned only once in passing by the innkeep ('Tamsin at the forge across the square') and then only resurfaces as a hidden stake ('costs standing with... Tamsin') in Mootcombe's orchard-question weighing text. Nothing else across 630+ turns points the player back to her; her whole thread is invisible unless the Vale forge is visited early.
